profile.headline: Full Stack Application Developer  | Systems Analysis | Workflow Automation | QA & Technical Enablement
profile.summary:
I improve the systems people rely on.

My background is in software engineering, systems analysis, workflow improvement, and technical enablement. At ADP, I work with C#, .NET, React, TypeScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, and Agile Scrum practices to support enterprise applications. I’ve also built reusable Mabl test automation and created Confluence documentation that reduced developer onboarding from two weeks to three days.

Through GemsForge, I help individuals, entrepreneurs, and small businesses reduce digital friction. I organize information, improve workflows, maintain existing web pages, build Notion dashboards and knowledge hubs, document repeatable processes, and connect tools through practical automation.

The through-line in my work is simple: understand the system, find the friction, improve the process, document it clearly, and make it easier for people to use and maintain.

I’m especially interested in software engineering, systems analysis, workflow automation, QA and test automation, implementation, and technical enablement roles.

positions.title: Full Stack Application Developer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain enterprise applications within an Agile Scrum team using C#, .NET, React, Redux, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and related technologies.

- Contribute to the team’s digital benefits-enrollment project by developing and maintaining user interfaces integrated with ADP Workforce Now.
- Supported the development of two enrollment-interface versions through feature work, troubleshooting, and iterative improvements.
- Improve React interfaces through accessible navigation, semantic structure, keyboard usability, and inclusive user experiences.
- Maintain accessible UI content, articles, and PDFs in accordance with project requirements.
- Create reusable low-code Mabl automation snippets and test steps to validate numerical and UI values.
- Investigate application issues using SQL queries, local debugging, and application monitoring.
- Document codebase processes and maintain Confluence pages to improve technical knowledge sharing.
- Created a development-environment guide that helped reduce incoming-developer onboarding from approximately two weeks to three days.
positions.insights: C# in .NET, Test Automation Tools and +17 skills

positions.title: Founder | Digital Solutions Analyst
positions.description: I help individuals, entrepreneurs, and small businesses improve the digital systems they rely on. I organize information, maintain web pages, build Notion dashboards and knowledge hubs, document workflows, troubleshoot tools, and design practical automations that reduce repetitive work. My work combines digital organization, workflow optimization, website maintenance, accessibility-minded improvements, technical documentation, and business systems implementation. I translate confusing or scattered digital processes into systems that are easier to use, maintain, and return to.
positions.insights: General Business Consulting, Branding & Identity and +9 skills

positions.title: Staff Sergeant | Squad Leader
positions.description:
- Support transportation operations, personnel accountability, equipment readiness, and safety requirements.
- Coordinate the loading, unloading, and secure movement of personnel and supplies.
- Supported emergency and FEMA relief operations in Georgia, including Hurricane Michael response efforts affecting more than 900,000 residents.
- Supported COVID-19 testing-site operations throughout 2020.
- Develop leadership, communication, logistics, and operational-planning skills through recurring training and mission preparation.
positions.insights: Program Management, Inventory Management and +6 skills

positions.title: Full-Stack Java Developer Apprentice
positions.description:
Completed UST’s Step IT Up apprenticeship in full-stack Java application development.

- Built a Spring Boot REST API for online I-9 forms as part of a team capstone project.
- Applied Java, object-oriented programming, REST API, and Agile Scrum practices.
- Served as team captain, coordinating communication, collaboration, and project workflow.
- Worked iteratively with teammates to plan, develop, test, and present the capstone application.
- Built the technical foundation for my transition into professional software development.

My family and I donated food and money to participate in the Hunger Walk/Run in Atlanta.
